history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration pilot practices for assessing and reporting on programme performance using the results available in the strategic planning, budgeting and performance management solution, as well as any relevant evaluation results of the Office of Internal Oversight Services, using the solution as one of the components for the assessment of the performance of senior managers.
history.administration_response: The Administration is currently undertaking two pilot analyses to address this recommendation by: (a) utilizing information generated by the strategic planning, budgeting and performance management solution to identify systemic issues with regard to programme implementation and reporting as part of the 2022 senior managers’ performance assessment exercise; and (b) augmenting existing quantitative measurements of OIOS evaluation implementation rates with a qualitative analysis of outstanding OIOS recommendations. Results of the pilot analyses will be presented to the Management Performance Board for their review and deliberation by December 2023.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration strengthened the analysis of information generated by the strategic planning, budgeting and performance management solution, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
